currentArchitecture.persistence: versioned RunPackage in IndexedDB; non-sensitive UI preferences in localStorage; legal profile session-only

experienceLens.invariant: The lens changes information density and explanation only, never source data, calculations, limits, or safety gates.
experienceLens.levelScaleDecision: A 1-10 scale is rejected until user research demonstrates ten distinguishable and useful states.

sessionOnly: imported legal profile without document payload

capabilities.evidence: React UI, canonical workbook snapshot, knowledge base, exports, tests and CI exist in this repository.
RunPackage schema v1, IndexedDB persistence, validated JSON restore, CSV/XLSX/PDF exports and migration-safe validation are implemented and tested.
Manual measured values are recorded separately from targets; canonical persistent alerts, acknowledgements and event history are implemented.
Web App Manifest and production service worker cache the application shell and canonical read-only datasets.
Validated JSON backup/restore plus CSV, XLSX, PDF and print outputs are available without a backend.

capabilities.trigger: A named device protocol, trust boundary, offline behavior and calibration model are approved.
Authenticated collaboration or cross-device synchronization becomes a validated requirement.
Browser-side PDF/XLSX export fails documented fidelity or performance criteria.
SSR, authenticated server features, dynamic route handlers, database access or server-side jobs provide measured product value.
